from tools import search_hotels, search_attractions, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached attraction results
attractions_result = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Search for hotels with the provided criteria
hotels_result = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-04"],
    num_people=4,
    budget=70,
    stars=[5],
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels_result)

# Search for touristy attractions in St. Louis
attractions_result = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Touristy"]
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions_result)

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotels
nearest_result = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels_result,
    attractions=attractions_result,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_result)
